review: AI-assisted provisional, source captions previously visible; test of the app, not human-adjudicated accuracy.
matched_unit: Use the representative edge recorded before inference for each of the 16 selected worker-machine pairs. An absent edge counts as unavailable for end-to-end coverage, never as a correct negative or a visual model abstention. Other edges are unscored.
relationship_scoring: Exact label agreement among determinate linked pairs, with relation unclear treated as abstention. Report the unassessable reference pair separately. Scene-graph rules supply only image-space proximity and no semantic relationship classification.
evidence_scoring: For each representative linked pair, compare the claimed worker support/contact with the original photo and provisional evidence: supported, contradicted, or indeterminate. A correct coarse label alone does not establish supported evidence. Account separately for abstained relations or absent edges.
hazards: Scored against pair-specific supported, unsupported and unassessable references. Report alerts on unassessable pairs separately from false alerts. No PPE reference scores are available for this batch.
ui_change_since_freeze: integrated_app.py optional-review path repair; frozen scene graphs and unchanged reasoning code used directly.
